thread:
sania: Heads-up: since the stricter mtls enforcement landed on the ingress gateway, weve seen a cluster-wide spike in 401/unauthorized between services that use short-lived client certs.
omar: Observed: cert-rotator logs show repeated CSR_SIGN_FAIL entries around 5240001240. Cause looks like KMS signing failures: \u201cAccessDenied: kms:Sign denied for role cert-rotator-eu\u201d.
lee: Confirmed in KMS audit: Unwrap/Decrypt allowed but Sign denied on key alias projects/rotator/keys/csr-signing-eu.
cert-rotator: We deployed a new role last night that had kms:Decrypt + kms:GetPublicKey but we forgot kms:Sign. The rotator tries a KMS-as-CA workflow (sign CSRs with HSM key).
sre-oncall: Impact: ~1.2% traffic returns auth errors; some services fallback to cached certs but expire after 10m leading to retries and queueing. No customer-facing outages yet but elevated latency and retries.
sec-bot: Triage: CVSS N/A (not protocol vuln) but high operational risk and compliance exposure because cert issuance failed and audit entries for sign attempts are not consistently forwarded. Need quick containment + root cause.
sania: Immediate options: 1) Emergency RBAC patch to add kms:Sign to rotator-eu role 2) Roll back mtls-enforce flag to allow previous certs for 30m 3) Enable rotator fallback to pre-signed cert bundle. Thoughts?
omar: Quickest: add kms:Sign to role with condition limiting to the single alias and requestor tag region: "eu-west". Example minimal policy: ```{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Sign"],
  "Resource": "projects/rotator/keys/csr-signing-eu",
  "Condition": { "StringEquals": {"requestor:region": "eu-west"} }
}``` This avoids broad grants.
cert-rotator: We can push the IAM patch now as a hotfix and restart two canary rotator pods. I'll instrument them to fail fast on Sign errors.
lee: Also we discovered our audit-forwarder drops KMS.Sign events when origin region != central. I'll enable cross-region audit forwarding to sec-audit and tag with key_alias + principal.
sre-oncall: Mitigation plan: - Push RBAC hotfix (ETA 10m) - Restart rotator canary pods (ETA 15m) - Verify new cert issuance in canary (5m window) - If successful, roll to all rotators.
sec-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-5240001234 (tag: csr-sign-kms-rbac). Please add timeline updates.
auditor-bot: Note: Compliance requirement: log of all private-key-sign operations must be preserved for 1 year. Ensure the forwarder preserves integrity (SHA256) and retention.
sania: Post-fix checks: - verify issuance rate back to baseline - audit events present in sec-audit within 60s - ensure no wildcard kms grants in role bindings.
omar: Follow-ups: add CI integration test that simulates kms:Sign deny to ensure rotator falls back gracefully and emits metric rotator.csr_sign.denied.
lee: Long-term: prefer external CA signing via a control-plane-signed container that requests ephemeral delegated signing tokens rather than long-lived kms:Sign grants per-rotator. Also document RBAC matrix per-region.
cert-rotator: Hotfix applied, role updated with kms:Sign on alias csr-signing-eu. Canaries reaped new certs at 5240001348.
sre-oncall: Monitoring: 5240001420 alert: CSR_SIGN_FAIL rate dropped from 1.2% -> 0.03% on canary cluster. Rolling to remaining rotators now.
sania: Good work. I'll capture timeline and actions in the incident doc and schedule a postmortem focusing on alias scoping, audit forwarding, and RBAC drift detection rules.
lee: I'll open PR with the minimal IAM JSON + audit forwarder config (link: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/1024).
sec-bot: Reminder: add ownership of key aliases to the Crypto SRE runbook and add synthetic that tries a Sign unwrap per region nightly.
sania: Thanks team :thumbsup:
